name: Quick Pill 5.3.0
changelog: Added Apple Dynamic Island Battery Hub with real-time drain analysis, battery duration forecasting, and Apple HIG layout.
Integrated 60 FPS Canvas-driven fluid wave physics engine with continuous right-to-left wave currents and buoyant micro-bubbles.
Redesigned horizontal Dynamic Island layout, improved settings dashboard, and enhanced clock widget.
Added native Windows WinRT media controls with direct support for Brave, Chrome, Spotify, Edge, and VLC.
Performance optimizations and UI responsiveness improvements across all display modes.
